تتداخلوا (form VI)
# تَتَدَاخَلُوا (tatadāḵalū) /ta.ta.daː.xa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# تُتَدَاخَلُوا (tutadāḵalū) /tu.ta.daː.xa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
